description: This file implements a network logging system for the Starboard platform, including socket management, buffered writing, and server handling for remote log collection.

classes.name: FunctionThread
classes.description: A thread class that runs a provided function in a separate thread.

classes.name: BufferedSocketWriter
classes.description: Handles buffered writing to a socket with in-memory buffer management.

classes.name: SocketListener
classes.description: Listens for incoming socket connections and invokes a callback upon connection.

classes.name: NetLogServer
classes.description: Singleton server managing network log connections and data transmission.

classes.name: ThreadLocalBoolean
classes.description: Manages thread-local boolean flags to prevent re-entrant logging behavior.

classes.name: ScopeGuard
classes.description: Ensures re-entrant behavior is disabled during logging operations.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts an SbSocketError code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: CreateListenSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to listen for incoming connections.
